A '''Vehicle Tool Kit''' was a [[Tool kit/Legends|tool kit]] intended to help an individual to perform repairs on vehicles. They were readily available for sale throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and generally cost 200 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] to purchase.<ref name="SWS" />
